categories.main_business_segments: KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, development, production, sales, and service of five-axis linkage CNC machine tools, high-end CNC systems, key functional components, and flexible automation production lines. Its product portfolio includes general-purpose five-axis vertical, horizontal, gantry, and horizontal milling-turning composite machining centers, as well as specialized machining centers such as tool grinding, blade machining, high-speed tip grinding, and six-axis five-linkage disk machining centers. The company also produces high-end CNC systems, servo drives, motors, sensors, electric spindles, milling heads, and rotary tables. It serves aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, mold, medical, and other industrial sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies including high-end CNC system technology, general and specialized five-axis CNC machine tool technology, direct-drive functional components, high-performance servo drive systems, high-precision sensing and detection technologies, and high-performance torque and spindle motors. It emphasizes platform-based modular design, high rigidity and precision in machine structures, and integration of advanced control algorithms such as RTCP and multi-axis coordination. Production methods include precision casting with mineral casting beds, advanced machining centers with multi-axis linkage, and flexible automation lines integrating fixtures, tooling, logistics, and intelligent software. The company also capitalizes significant R&D investments to develop new models and improve manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KEDE serves primarily aerospace and defense sectors, including major domestic groups like Aero Engine Corporation of China, AVIC, CASC, and CASIC, supplying complex parts such as turbine blades, disks, and aircraft structural components. It also serves energy, automotive (notably new energy vehicles), mold, tooling, medical devices, and semiconductor industries. The company has expanded into flexible automation production lines for multi-variety, small-batch, customized manufacturing. Its customers include leading enterprises in oil and gas, power generation, automotive parts, and educational institutions for training purposes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with key markets in Northeast China, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest China, and Southwest China. Its headquarters and main production facilities are located in Dalian Economic and Technological Development Zone, with subsidiaries in Chongqing, Shaanxi, Ningxia, and Shenyang. The company also engages with international markets through exports and cooperation but primarily focuses on domestic high-end manufacturing sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: KEDE operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the CNC machine tool supply chain. It manufactures complete high-end CNC machine tools and key functional components such as CNC systems, servo drives, motors, and sensors. The company also provides integrated flexible automation production lines, positioning itself as a system integrator and solution provider. It sources some standard parts externally but maintains high self-sufficiency in core technologies and components, enabling import substitution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on core technology self-reliance and import substitution in high-end five-axis CNC machine tools and related components. It pursues platform-based modular technology development, continuous innovation in CNC systems and direct-drive components, and expansion of product lines to cover diverse industrial applications. R&D priorities include intelligent CNC systems with AI integration, high-precision machining centers for aerospace and new energy vehicles, and flexible automation solutions. The company invests heavily in patent development, national key projects, and collaborates with universities and research institutes to enhance innovation capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: KEDE generates revenue primarily through the sale of high-end CNC machine tools, high-end CNC systems, key functional components, and flexible automation production lines. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products or completion of services such as installation and maintenance. The company employs a direct sales model supported by technical pre-sales and after-sales services, supplemented by distributor sales domestically and internationally. It also earns income from independent sales of key components and related technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KEDE is positioned as a leading domestic innovator in high-end five-axis CNC machine tools and systems, competing against established international brands from Germany, Japan, and the USA, such as Mazak, DMG MORI, Siemens, and HEIDENHAIN. It holds a significant market share in China’s five-axis vertical machining center segment, with a strong focus on import substitution and core technology independence. The company is recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise and a provincial manufacturing champion, distinguishing itself through its dual R&D system for CNC systems and machine tools.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, KEDE achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 605 million, representing a 33.88% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 130 million, up 27.37%. The company’s total assets grew by over 50% to RMB 2.26 billion, and net assets increased by 61.24% to RMB 1.83 billion. R&D investment accounted for 26.86% of revenue, reflecting strong commitment to innovation. The company’s sales volume includes 225 high-end CNC machine tools, with a product mix increasingly weighted towards high-value, complex models. KEDE has successfully completed multiple rounds of equity financing to support capacity expansion and technology development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KEDE emphasizes its core competitive advantage in proprietary high-end CNC system technology and key functional components, enabling high precision, efficiency, and reliability in complex multi-axis machining. Its products offer high dynamic response, rigidity, and thermal stability, tailored for critical aerospace, defense, and advanced manufacturing applications. The company provides comprehensive pre-sales technical support and after-sales services, including customized processing solutions and turnkey projects, enhancing customer loyalty. Its flexible automation production lines address the growing demand for multi-variety, small-batch, and customized manufacturing, positioning KEDE as a provider of integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions with strong domestic localization and import substitution capabilities.
